timeline.tweet: I'll try to repress the sad feelings, then.
Waken up by the heat, tried to get myself back to sleep by chanting "Don't have to go to work tmrw" to myself, bc. v. tired. The heat won.🐙💦
A chill ran down my spine. 😰

I have been diagnosed with depression for years now & one of the things that make me feel better is doing something beautiful, useful or both. But when I can't do that, by lack of time, energy, etc. I find happiness in learning what others have been doing that made them happy. 💓

Perhaps because it gives you a feeling of being in control of what hurts you, instead of being receiving the pain inflicted by others on whom we seem to have no control whatsoever. But you have to be careful about self-harm, it's a vicious spiral. Please, break away from it.😢💓

One early mistake I kept making in order to keep myself away from suicidal thoughts was to add things on my "things I have to do before committing suicide" list. It was a _bad_ idea. Now I have an ever increasing list of "things to do because I want to do them for myself".
... This is still going on, and it is very very hot !
"If you're constantly anxious and you know it, and you really hate to show it, clap your hands." 👏🏻👏🏻
My anxiety usually tie my insides into knots. 😦
This heatwave is giving me headaches and the sensations of an ice cube in an oven, but hopefully we'll stay hydrated and alive until the big rainstorms arrive. 🤞⛈
